screens.notes: Search covers item name, SKU and barcode; category filter, availability, resolved starting price, pricing mode and add-on count are visible. Inventory filters/import/export remain outside scope.

screens.name: Item Editor
screens.notes: Current editor exposes fixed or reusable/item-private multiple pricing, reusable/private add-ons and merchant POS appearance by color/shape or image staging. Legacy generated variants are migration-only. Cost, stock, tax, per-store overrides, production media storage and POS option/add-on selection remain gated.

screens.name: Reusable Option Groups and Multiple Pricing
screens.notes: Merchant-facing concept is مجموعات الخيارات. Groups hold reusable values, direct default prices and current staging accent color. Items can inherit the group, sparsely override prices, or use item-only custom choices. Current POS selection remains separately gated.

screens.name: Categories
screens.notes: Create, rename and merchant-selected accent color are implemented in current staging semantics. Delete and reorder remain outside scope.

screens.name: Add-ons

flows.name: Retail Cash Sale Vertical Slice
entryPoints: POS-SCREEN-001 for an unlinked mock device
POS-SCREEN-002 for an already linked device

steps.scope: existing-account sign-in only; optional when device is already linked
four-digit employee PIN unlock only
open an empty local ticket
search current local catalog reader
add fixed-price item without unresolved pricing options/add-ons/open price
set line quantity and show deterministic totals
optionally remove an unsaved line and restore empty-ticket when the last line is removed
optionally save the active ticket locally and begin a fresh ticket; full listing/reopening remain outside this slice
enter payment selection
select cash for the authorized cash slice
confirm exact or over tender and compute visible change through current Rifad runtime contract
optional current print behavior with queued/failed/delivery-unknown visible states
optional current email-receipt behavior; production delivery/queue policy remains unfrozen
return to a new empty ticket

flows.offlineVariant: After device link, PIN, catalog, ticket editing, cash completion and current local printing behavior remain available through the local/mock runtime. Production connected payment methods remain outside this flow.
nonGoals: pricing-option chooser, add-ons, open price or weighed items
customer/loyalty production authorization or cloud persistence
full open-ticket list/reopening lifecycle, tables or real KDS/CDS propagation
final fiscal, production database, synchronization or hardware implementation
acceptanceCriteria: Every permitted business action calls the named Rifad draft contract through the injected runtime/adapters.
No business mutation is implemented as component-local authority.
Tablet layout preserves catalog/ticket hierarchy and mirrors structurally in RTL.
Phone layout uses separate catalog and ticket surfaces rather than shrinking the tablet split.
Windows keyboard/mouse interaction does not remove touch-sized controls.
Cash completion uses one stable idempotent command identity and exact Rifad Money values.
Loading, invalid PIN, empty ticket, no search results, under-tender, payment rejection, print failure and delivery-unknown are visibly testable where applicable.
A refresh/restart test restores the declared current local state for the active flow.
The UI uses Rifad branding and no unapproved visual donor pattern.
Visual, interaction and contract tests reference POS-FLOW-001 and its screen/action IDs.

flows.name: Restaurant Local Service Prototype

sections: 35. تدفق مطعم: Open ticket ثم KDS ثم الدفع

steps.scope: choose retail/off, simple restaurant, or advanced place-management staging configuration
in simple restaurant mode, Local enters existing checkout with local/dine-in presentation context and no place selector
in advanced mode choose a free place, persist a local mock open order, increment initial kitchen revision and clear the working basket
from an empty basket open the occupied-place view and reconstruct the stored local order into the current mock sales ticket
send edited/reopened order back to local mock preparation state, increment revision and clear the working basket
after existing checkout completion, close the matching mock open order and make the service place available

flows.offlineVariant: Restaurant configuration, service places and open local orders persist through current local staging state and do not require cloud connectivity for this UI proof.
acceptanceCriteria: Restaurant service OFF hides restaurant language and leaves direct Pay usable for retail.
Simple restaurant mode exposes Local without asking for a table or room and enters the existing checkout in one touch.
Advanced mode exposes area/place targets without decorative furniture reducing touch size.
Assigning a free place creates one local mock open order, shows kitchen-send feedback and clears the working basket.
An empty basket with open local orders promotes Open Orders in the stable right action slot while Pay stays disabled in its unchanged left slot.
Opening an occupied place reconstructs the order for editing and preserves the stable transaction footer.
Sending additions updates the stored order and increments the mock kitchen revision instead of creating a second open place.
Completing payment for a reopened order releases the stored place.
Open orders block disabling restaurant/place management until they are closed.
The prototype never claims real KDS, printer, fiscal or multi-device synchronization evidence.

Creating a page enters a visible fixed-slot layout editor.
Create/rename/move/delete/place/remove actions call the named Rifad SaleLayoutContract methods.
The saved page structure and tile placement survive application reload through the current local runtime.
Default/protected page rules remain domain-owned rather than component-local hacks.
Layout editing preserves the Rifad palette and documented Loyverse interaction hierarchy without copying donor code or assets.
Tests reference POS-FLOW-006 and its screen/action IDs.

steps.scope: navigate only within the implemented catalog family: item list, categories, reusable option groups and add-ons; other Back Office families remain unavailable
load item rows; search item name/SKU/barcode and filter by category
load categories, reusable pricing option groups and reusable add-on groups into the item editor
create/edit reusable option groups including current accent color and configure fixed, inherited-group, sparse item-override or item-private multiple pricing
optionally assign reusable general add-ons, define item-private add-ons and configure current POS appearance semantics
create an item with the current pricing/add-on/appearance catalog payload
edit the current catalog payload while preserving stable item identity
create/rename a category and set current accent color while preserving stable category identity
create/edit reusable general add-on groups with accent color, named options and exact additional prices

flows.offlineVariant: The current browser staging adapter persists catalog edits locally and migrates current staging shapes to schema v4. This proves Rifad catalog semantics, not production Back Office topology or LAN/cloud synchronization between separately hosted applications.
nonGoals: POS pricing-option/add-on chooser and sold snapshots
acceptanceCriteria: Back Office renders the locked RTL management shell with only the catalog family active and unrelated future families visibly disabled.
Item list can search base item identity and filter by category while showing pricing mode and effective starting price.
Create/edit/category/option-group/add-on mutations call Rifad CatalogAdminContract rather than component-local business state.
Money crosses the contract as exact halalas.
Reusable option groups carry named values with direct default prices and current merchant accent color and can serve many items.
An item can inherit a reusable group's prices, sparsely override only differing values, or define item-private multiple prices.
Enabling multiple prices disables the fixed-price input in the merchant UI.
Reusable general add-on groups can be created/edited with accent color and assigned to items, while item-private add-ons remain scoped to one item.
Categories can be created/renamed and assigned merchant accent color while retaining stable identity.
Item editor can configure current catalog appearance semantics by color/shape or browser-staging image without making image transport sale truth.
Turning off Available for sale keeps the item in Back Office while hiding it from the current POS sellable catalog.
Option-priced items remain hidden from the current POS reader until POS-SCREEN-005 is separately authorized, preventing fallback/minimum-price selling.
Legacy generated-variant structures remain migration-only and are not exposed as the current merchant workflow.
Catalog storage/transport remains replaceable; current browser staging is not presented as LAN/cloud sync or production media storage.
Tests reference BO-FLOW-002 and preserve existing fixed-price POS behavior.
